Aldila Ascent Blue PL OEM shaft — GlobalGolf

Aldila's official ASCENT PL wood specification identifies a 2023 family with five canonical variants only: PL 40 W/A/R and PL 50 A/R, all 46 inches. OEM/retail evidence using the names 'Ascent Blue' or 'Ascent Blue PL' includes materially different configurations such as a Cleveland-branded PL Blue 40 Stiff at 46 g / 6.6° and Tour Edge driver offerings labelled Ascent Blue 45/50/55. Therefore 'Ascent Blue' is an OEM-specific/shorthand naming layer, not a safely defined standalone 2022 aftermarket family. Do not create a generic shaft_key or merge these OEM variants into ASCENT PL without OEM-specific records.

Resolved as an ambiguous OEM naming layer rather than a canonical standalone family.
